name: Dorian LPG
verdict: OWNABLE — 0.35% leg of the 1.25% Hormuz-drip sleeve (ONE bet, class-sliced)
mechanics: VLGC: net-positive drip mechanics — MEG liftings hold in a throttled-but-flowing regime PLUS US-Gulf->Asia substitution ton-miles (US ~60% of VLGC trade growth) + risk premium; cleaner than BWLP (pure Helios spot, no dampening services arm). edge_explainer.market_believes: The June deal ended the tanker trade — every strait name round-tripped.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The reopening plateaued at a third of normal while rates still print at multiples of it; this name adds a gas-carrier leg where US-substitution voyages inflate ton-miles to the same underlying position.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Same as FRO: attention to the weekly physical tape vs a market that closed the episode in five sessions. Crowded complex — sleeve-capped accordingly.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: 60% our own number that the strait substantially reopens by Aug-31 — the cushion (price at/near pre-episode) is what makes that survivable.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Weekly transits + premia; Q2 prints ~Aug; Aug-31 adjudication.
